definition: A hash table, or a hash map, is a data structure that implements an associative array abstract data type, a structure that can map keys to values.
details: A hash table, or a hash map, is a data structure that implements an associative array abstract data type, a structure that can map keys to values. A hash table uses a hash function to compute an index into an array of buckets or slots, from which the desired value can be found.
